chunks: They ask you about the spoils of war. Say: 'The spoils belong to Allah and the Messenger.' So fear Allah and set right the relation between yourselves, and obey Allah and His Messenger, if you are believers.

key_terms.الْأَنفَالِ: Spoils of war or surplus benefits

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on the distribution of spoils of war (Anfal) in Islam?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is pivotal for establishing the Prophet's exclusive authority in distributing war booty, a prerogative later extended to the Imams as the rightful successors. It links material governance with spiritual unity, urging believers to rectify internal discord (islah al-dhat al-bayn) as a prerequisite for true obedience to divine command.
